name: erasechat
description: Bulk delete and clean your own content on Slack, Reddit, X, Mastodon, Microsoft Teams, and Telegram, with advanced filters and strong safety controls.
author: Yogesh Bhatt <yogeshb@prosperix.com>

scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo "pre-push guard active (main: no force-push, no deletion, gate must pass)"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run build && npm run validate:firefox
